sloka: स लक्ष्मणो रावणसायकार्तश्चचाल चापं शिथिलं प्रगृह्य ।पुनश्च सञ्ज्ञां प्रतिलभ्य कृच्छ्राच्चिच्छेद चापं त्रिदशेन्द्रशत्रोः ।। ६.५९.१०५ ।।।।
transliteration: sa lakṣmaṇo rāvaṇasāyakārtaścacāla cāpaṁ śithilaṁ pragṛhya ।punaśca sañjñāṁ pratilabhya kṛcchrācciccheda cāpaṁ tridaśendraśatroḥ ।। 6.59.105 ।।।।

translations.english: The Rakshasa king broke into pieces those arrows of Lakshmana and struck him on the forehead with the arrow gifted to him by Brahma, that was bright like the fire at the time of universal destruction.
